name: CKB eCommerce (OTP banka, formerly Crnogorska komercijalna banka)

ME.why: A Montenegrin bank's own e-commerce service, for legal-entity clients with a year-old account and at least 100,000 EUR a year of payments through the bank.

evidence.quote: CKB eCommerce servis namijenjen je svim klijentima, pravnim licima, koja: imaju otvoren račun najmanje jednu godinu … imaju godišnji platni promet preko CKB-a od minimalno 100.000,00 EUR
evidence.english: The CKB eCommerce service is meant for all clients that are legal entities and that have had an account for at least a year … and move at least 100,000 EUR a year through CKB.

company.quote: CKB eCommerce servis namijenjen je svim klijentima, pravnim licima
company.english: The CKB eCommerce service is meant for all clients that are legal entities.

docs.note: The product page promises a test package and test server, with no public docs.

pricing.note: Fee list for legal entities and sole traders, section 21, E-commerce sistem.

signup.note: A meeting-booking page for legal entities; no e-commerce application.
